gap: No result ChatGPT got states SoundGuys' side-by-side mic and battery results: 79% of 1,079 listeners rated the Shokz OpenComm2 UC boom mic Good or Perfect, against 58% of 923 for the Soundcore AeroFit 2, and the OpenComm2 UC measured 17 h 59 min of playback on one charge.
standout_why: I opened realbuyerexperiences.com (cited). It says it 'did not test these units first-hand' and quotes only maker specs, with no mic results. I opened SoundGuys' open-ear roundup (cited in chat 3). It shows '0 of 3 Measurements' for every pick and has no mic samples or poll numbers. I opened openearclub's work page (cited). Its call scores are its own rubric marks with no test behind them, and every battery figure is a maker spec. RTINGS' OpenComm2 2025 review (cited in chat 2) locks its mic results ('Speech + Pink Noise Handling Locked') and its continuous battery life, so a shopper can't see them. I did not open the two cited Digital Trends pages or the cited soundcore blog, so I can't rule out that they quote a figure. Digital Trends doesn't run a measurement lab, and the soundcore blog is the maker's own.
decides: It backs ChatGPT's pick of the boom-mic OpenComm2 for calls with a named, numbered listener result: 79% Good/Perfect against 58% for the AeroFit 2, the budget pick ChatGPT showed. It also measures the battery behind the 16 h talk claim at 17 h 59 min. The caveat is that SoundGuys tested the 2023 OpenComm2 UC on firmware 409-27, not the 2025 model, so the page must say which model was tested. For our AeroClip 2 lead, no independent lab has published a numbered mic test I could open. The only third-party claim is a Guinness record category, with no score shown on the page, so it can't beat the OpenComm2 on measured evidence.

findings.label: Battery life, SoundGuys standard test
findings.value: 17 h 59 min playback on one charge
findings.note: Jasper Lastoria, published 2023-11-27. Unit on firmware 409-27 with Shokz Connect v1.2.5. Battery score 8.9/10. This is the 2023 model, not the 2025 OpenComm2.

findings.label: SoundGuys mic listener poll (ideal-conditions demo)
findings.value: 79% Good or Perfect (49% Good, 30% Perfect, 15% Okay, 1% Bad, 4% Awful), 1,079 votes
findings.note: 79 = 49 + 30. Lastoria: 'ambient street noise is virtually eliminated'; 'some wind will make it through the filtering'; 'some keystrokes can be heard' in an office.

findings.label: SoundGuys mic listener poll
findings.value: 58% Good or Perfect (46% Good, 12% Perfect, 34% Okay, 4% Bad, 5% Awful), 923 votes
findings.note: Dave Carr, published 2024-10-29. 58 = 46 + 12. Says the AeroFit 2 'aren't especially great at rejecting background noise in our simulated office environment' but 'hold up in our simulated windy conditions test'. SoundGuys lists battery as 'Not measured for this product'. Overall rating 5.3/10, 'Not recommended'.

findings.label: Battery runtime, headphonecheck.com
findings.value: 9 h at high volume over AAC; 41 h 30 min with case; 10 min charge gives 4 h 15 min
findings.source_title: Soundcore AeroFit 2 by Anker test - headphonecheck.com
findings.note: Maike Paeßens, page last updated 2024-10-22. Soundcore claims 10 h / 42 h. The review gives no mic figures, only qualitative notes ('wind noise largely filtered out').

findings.label: Battery life, SoundGuys testing
findings.value: up to 11 h on one charge
findings.note: Adam Birney, published 2025-03-12. The text says '11 hours on a single charge in our testing' without test conditions. Battery score 7.5/10. The review has no mic section and no listener poll.

findings.label: RTINGS test status
findings.value: Test Bench 2.3, updated 2026-06-23; mic and continuous-battery results locked
findings.note: Read as text through r.jina.ai because the direct fetch returned only navigation. The page shows 'Speech + Pink Noise Handling Locked', 'Speech + Subway Noise Handling Locked' and 'Continuous Battery Life Locked'. No usable figures.

findings.label: Third-party speech-quality certification
findings.value: Guinness World Records, 'Highest speech quality score (G-MOS) for open-ear clip-on earbuds (objective test)', certified 2026-08-31
findings.source_title: AeroClip 2 Clip-On Earbuds with Clearest Calls - soundcore US

The record covers only clip-on open-ear earbuds, so it says nothing about the boom-mic headsets. The same page lists $169.99 US, 4 mics + 2 VPUs, 6.2 g per bud, IP57 and playtime 8 h / 32 h.

findings.source_title: Anker Soundcore AeroClip 2 review - Expert Reviews
findings.note: Andy White, published 2026-10-30. No numbered mic figures. Battery figures are the maker's 8 h / 32 h rating, not his own test.
